posts.post: Friendly reminder that your wardrobe is a visual resume of your discipline. STRAYED is for those who stopped signaling and started operating.
The moment you understand that comfort is a decay function, you stop looking for it.
Fun fact: If you're not documenting your failures, you're not paying off your ignorance debt. You're just repeating it.
If you're not hitting your revenue goals, consider checking your input volume before your strategy. Strategy is a luxury for those already moving.
